role: Shared header for the world-core probe gates: manifest int/string readers, LE readers, the chunk byte layout the oracle hashes (ids, metas, sky and block light, heightMap, precipitationHeightMap, heightMapMinimum, section mask), the 3x3 FNV-1a chunk hash, the loaded-chunk list, the per-chunk and whole-region (final.bin.gz) comparisons, and sampled hashing with --hash-all rerun. --cases N takes the first N cases only, without the end-of-run compares (probe_limit; make smoke).
notes: PROBE_HASH_EVERY=64: the 3x3 hash is checked every 64th case and on the last; probe_localize execl()s the test again with --hash-all after a failure. static int probe_hash_never is declared twice (lines 37 and 51, a legal tentative definition). hash_around loads missing rim chunks through world_chunk, so the native chunk load order must match the probe's. Test code, built only into out/native/test_*; not on the product or GPU path, so no GPU hazards are listed.
